(total % 10)) % 10\n    return control == digits[10]\n\n\ndef _hamming(a: str, b: str) -> int:\n    return sum(1 for x, y in zip(a, b) if x != y)\n\n\ndef _build_employee_id_correction(valid_pesels, unknown_ids):\n    \"\"\"Map unknown/corrupted employee ids in the timesheet to the closest\n    valid PESEL found in employees.csv (data entry typos).\"\"\"\n    correction = {}\n    for uid in unknown_ids:\n        if len(uid) != 11 or not uid.isdigit():\n            continue\n        best = min(valid_pesels, key=lambda v: _hamming(uid, v))\n        if _hamming(uid, best) <= 3:\n            correction[uid] = best\n    return correction\n\n\ndef _fix_date(date_str: str) -> datetime.date:\n    \"\"\"Clamp impossible calendar days (e.g. Apr 31, Jun 31) to the last\n    valid day of that month.\"\"\"\n    y, m, d = (int(p) for p in date_str.split(\"-\"))\n    last_day = calendar.monthrange(y, m)[1]\n    if d > last_day:\n        d = last_day\n    return datetime.date(y, m, d)\n\n\ndef _parse_task_ids(raw: str):\n    s = raw.strip().strip(\"[]\")\n    if not s:\n        return []\n    return [x.strip() for x in s.split(\",\") if x.strip()]\n\n\ndef _round_half_up(value: float) -> int:\n    return int(Decimal(str(value)).quantize(Decimal(\"1\"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))\n\n\ndef answer() -> dict:\n    with open(EMPLOYEES_CSV, newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        employees = list(csv.DictReader(f))\n    hourly_rate = {r[\"PESEL\"]: float(r[\"hourly_rate\"]) for r in employees}\n    valid_pesels = set(hourly_rate.keys())\n\n    with open(TASKS_CSV, newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        tasks = list(csv.DictReader(f))\n    task_pay = {r[\"task_id\"]: float(r[\"pay_per_completion\"]) for r in tasks}\n    valid_task_ids = set(task_pay.keys())\n\n    with open(TIMESHEET_CSV, newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        timesheet = list(csv.DictReader(f))\n\n    unknown_ids = {r[\"employee_id\"] for r in timesheet} -
